topic: George Washington's dentures made partly from teeth of people he enslaved, and the Waterloo teeth trade
title: The Dark Truth Behind George Washington's 'Wooden' Teeth
description: AI-narrated commentary on the real history behind George Washington's dentures and the grim 'Waterloo teeth' trade, not a reenactment or summary of any existing video or its footage.

hook_candidates.text: George Washington's teeth weren't wood, some of them came from people he enslaved.
Everyone learns Washington had wooden teeth in school. He never did, and the truth is far darker.
What do you think happened to fifty thousand dead soldiers' teeth after the Battle of Waterloo?
In 1815, scavengers walked across a battlefield with pliers, hunting for one very specific thing.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who insists Washington's teeth were literally made of wood, because they want to show him what the dentures were actually made from.
contradicted_belief: Most people believe George Washington's famous false teeth were carved from plain wood.
closing_comment: Washington's dentures and the Waterloo dead soldiers' teeth both hide the same story the wood myth was built to cover up.

sources.note: Confirms Washington's dentures used human, animal, and ivory teeth, not wood, some teeth from enslaved people.
Confirms scavengers pulled teeth from tens of thousands of dead soldiers at Waterloo in 1815 for denture-making.
